Author: mr-reeh
Name: Can't You See I'm Busy
Punchline: Plays an emote when you open the map or a crafting/gathering/fishing log.
Description: Automatically triggers /navigate when you open the world or zone map, and /study when you open the Crafting, Gathering, or Fishing Log. /navigate and /study can interrupt each other; the map won't re-trigger itself for 13 seconds.
